grants.description: Verify your identity and age using your GOV.UK One Login credentials
grants.purpose: To confirm you are aged 75 or over and verify your identity

grants.description: Check your Pension Credit status with the Department for Work and Pensions (DWP)
grants.purpose: To verify you are receiving Pension Credit and are eligible for a free TV licence

grants.description: Confirm your home address for the TV licence registration
grants.purpose: To register your free TV licence to the correct household address

grants.description: Share information about your household to confirm licence eligibility
grants.purpose: To ensure the free licence is correctly applied to your household

revocation.mechanism: Contact TV Licensing or revoke through your GOV.UK account
revocation.effect: Application will be cancelled if consent is revoked before completion. You will need to reapply and grant consent again.

delegation.limitations: Agent cannot apply for Pension Credit on your behalf. Agent cannot change your address without your explicit confirmation. Agent cannot cancel an existing paid TV licence without your explicit instruction.
